speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a concerning rash and recent health changes; can you please describe exactly what the rash looks like, where it is located, and when it first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity reaction (DRESS syndrome).
